strategy_rules: Probabilities are the model's TRUE calibrated win probability — no display inflation (pitcher stats point-in-time)
Each day: pick the highest-scoring ticket among qualified 2/3/4-leg parlays or a +EV single
Parlay legs must pass edge/probability gates; 3-leg+ requires multiple High/Elite anchors
Singles only when they score higher than any qualified parlay that day
Official ticket locks at first 11 AM CT publish — never changes later in the day
Growth ratchet: 45% parlay / 30% single below $200, steps down as bankroll grows
